summary_en: This Phase 1/2 study tests new dose ramp-up schedules for the drug sonrotoclax, given with zanubrutinib, in adults with chronic lymphocytic leukemia or mantle cell lymphoma. Participants first take zanubrutinib alone, then add oral sonrotoclax using a ramp-up schedule, for 15 cycles of 28 days in one arm or 27 cycles of 28 days in the other, with the second arm then continuing zanubrutinib alone until progression or other stopping criteria. The main goal stated is to establish the safety of these novel dosing and ramp-up schedules.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1/2 evalúa nuevos esquemas de aumento gradual de dosis del medicamento sonrotoclax, administrado junto con zanubrutinib, en adultos con leucemia linfocítica crónica o linfoma de células del manto. Los participantes primero toman zanubrutinib solo y luego agregan sonrotoclax oral con un esquema de aumento gradual, durante 15 ciclos de 28 días en un grupo o 27 ciclos de 28 días en el otro, y en este último grupo continúan con zanubrutinib solo hasta la progresión u otros criterios de suspensión. El objetivo principal indicado es establecer la seguridad de estos nuevos esquemas de dosis y de aumento gradual.
who_for: Stable ECOG performance status of 2 or better.
Adequate organ function and no very recent transfusion or blood growth factor.
CLL: confirmed diagnosis needing treatment, with at least one measurable lesion on CT or MRI.
MCL: confirmed diagnosis, relapsed or refractory after at least one prior line of systemic therapy, with measurable disease.
Participants who can have children must use a highly effective birth control method.
not_for: Unable to comply with the protocol requirements.
Active hepatitis B or hepatitis C infection.
Positive HIV serology, unless certain conditions are met.
Major surgical procedure within 28 days before the first dose.
Prior systemic treatment for CLL, or prior exposure to a BCL-2 inhibitor.
